scope: Unchanged Windows SDK alpha GUI translated into Wasm inside browser with actual Wine base DLLs. Seven stages in EXE/ZIP/catalog modes verify 86400 drawing-area pixels against desktop Wine SDK snapshots: constant and pixel alpha, low opacity rounding, copied region clips, zero/full opacity, and both gdi32 and msimg32 entry points. Native guest checks raw destination alpha bytes. Universal Windows/DLL support remains incomplete.
oracleReference: Wine11 desktop x86 macOS; actual native AlphaBlend on selected 32-bit DIBs, GetPixel and raw destination memory including reserved alpha
